items.information: 🇧🇷 Está competição é gratuita. Inscreva-se na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HUNbelievableChallengeBSB2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 This competition is free. Register in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HUNbelievableChallengeBSB2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MTc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40f0b0ad2a63f826b853c4809fa9d880c9f4d4d1/Road%20to%20Nats%20Maracay%202026%20logo.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Road to Nats Maracay 2026 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **40 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMaracayII2026#79334-nuevos-competidores-newcomers) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, contactar al equipo organizador. #### 📸 Aviso de Filmación Al asistir a **Road to Nats Maracay 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Road to Nats Maracay 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **40**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMaracayII2026#79335-) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Road to Nats Maracay 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Enrymar!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Road%20to%20Nats%20Maracay%202026*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Antonio Sánchez: Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Rafael!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Road%20to%20Nats%20Maracay%202026*) rafaelmachele@gmail.com
